explanation: MarketListingsPage renders a seller block and formatListingDelivery(listing.delivery). The mock listing lacked the delivery object and the seller reputation fields, so rendering threw and the page crashed into the error boundary. In addition the price formatter was changed to print numbers without the currency symbol.
fix: Add the delivery object and seller reputation fields (verified, ratingAvg, ratingCount, salesCount) to the mock listing and change the price assertion from '฿15,000' to '15,000'.
